python_script_execution.name: Python Script Execution
python_script_execution.description: When running Python scripts in this repository from the command line, you may encounter `ModuleNotFoundError`. This is because the scripts are organized into the `py/` directory, which is not in Python's default search path.

solutions.name: Run the script as a module

python_script_execution.note: The shell scripts in the `sh/` directory (e.g., `sync_to_drive.sh`) already handle this for you by setting the `PYTHONPATH`.
